title: Where the Bottleneck Moved
description: Accuracy over parallelism: Nabil A on going from seven parallel coding agents back to one, AWS's six-control gated review pipeline with risk tiers, StarSling's A/B-tested self-improving CI, GitHub Event Streams and new agent safety and measurement tools, and Azure SRE Agent at Ignite. Practical idea: a deterministic risk-tier labeller for every agent PR.
